feedback.end: Modern bhangra is a genre that combines folk music from the Punjab region of India and Pakistan with western pop music.

instruction.text: Match the correct names to the musical instruments of traditional bhangra.

b.sound: A doll is a type of drum.
A toombee only has one string.

finish.text: The most important instrument in traditional bhangra is the dhol. It is a two-headed drum that is used to create a typical bhangra rhythm called a chaal.
finish.sound: The most important instrument in traditional bhangra is the doll. It is a two-headed drum that is used to create a typical bhangra rhythm called a charl.

atoms.b: In the 1960s and 1970s, the British Punjabi community began to record bhangra folk ((++songs hats)).
These songs often came with dances because bhangra is traditionally a type of ((++dance food)).
Sadly, lots of people had racist attitudes towards the British Punjabi community, so they wouldn’t listen to their ((++music books)).
It wasn’t until people started mixing ((++bhangra chocolate)) with pop and rock music that it gained ((++popularity speed)) across the UK and in other countries too.

finish.text: Traditional instruments, such as the dhol, were used less in bhangra when it was mixed with pop music. Instruments like electric drums and keyboards were used more.

atoms.sound: People call me the godfather of bhangra in the UK because I helped to make it popular here.

finish.text: Channi Singh is the co-founder of a band called Alaap. Their album Teri Chunni De Sitare was one of the first major bhangra hits in the UK, and it helped to give bhangra a big platform.
